title: 第282章 龙君化龙会第281章 忠义不能两全
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
相遇后的第三天。
顾铮脸色微微一变，胸口处传来一阵剧烈的悸动，那块被他收在怀中的玉质钥匙，此刻仿佛活过来了一般，正在疯狂跳动，如同一只饿了三天的饕餮忽然嗅到了满桌珍馐美味的气息，那股跃跃欲试的冲动几乎要从他的胸腔中破体而出！
他下意识地捂住胸口，却依然能清晰地感受到那钥匙的跳动频率越来越快，越来越剧烈，仿佛下一秒就要挣脱束缚，自行飞向某个方向。
他与敖言溪对视了一眼。
两人目光交汇的瞬间，都从对方眼中看到了同样的信号。
洞天，开了。
相视一笑，心念一动，几人的身形齐齐消失在了原地。
顾铮手中有一枚钥匙，带着阚城贤一同进入了洞天。
而敖言溪手中则有足足三枚钥匙，绰绰有余。
事实上，就算没有阚城贤这一茬，顾铮也完全可以跟着敖言溪进去。
只不过，若是没有中途救下阚城贤这段插曲，顾铮此刻大概已经在另一条路上忙着刷精粹了，也就不会与敖言溪在此重逢。
光影流转，时空交错。
当顾铮再次睁开眼时，映入眼帘的是一片截然不同的天地。
天空呈现出一种淡淡的琥珀色，像是被某种古老的光晕浸染过一般，没有太阳，却有柔和的光线从四面八方洒落。
远处是连绵起伏的山脉，山势巍峨，云雾缭绕，隐约可见巨大的飞禽在云层中穿行。空气中弥漫着浓郁的灵气，比外界浓郁了数倍不止，每一次呼吸都能感觉到体内的真气在欢快地运转。
这片洞天，几乎可以说是另一个世界。
或许不如大乾疆域那般辽阔，但根据消息，至少也有四五州之地的大小。
山川河流、平原森林、湖泊沼泽，各种地貌应有尽有，仿佛一个完整的生态系统在其中独立运转了数千万年。
顾铮心念一动，尝试着沟通现代世界的坐标，可行。
他依然能自由往返于两界之间，这让他心中安定不少。

他收回心神，目光投向不远处。
敖言溪、青青、胡姨、林文、林武、敖煜，以及被他带来的阚城贤，都完好无损地出现在了同一片区域内。
而在他们的正前方，约莫数里之外，赫然矗立着一座城池。
城墙高大厚重，城门敞开，隐约可见城中人来人往，炊烟袅袅，竟是一座颇为繁华的城镇。
“进去看看。”敖言溪提议道。
众人自然没有异议，便一同朝着那座城池走去。
进城之后，顾铮发现这座城比想象中要热闹得多。
content_en:
The third day after the encounter.
Gu Zheng's face changed slightly, and there was a violent throbbing in his chest. The jade key that he had kept in his arms seemed to have come to life at this moment, and was beating wildly, like a glutton that had been hungry for three days and suddenly smelled the aroma of delicacies on the table. The eager impulse almost burst out of his chest!
He subconsciously covered his chest, but he could still clearly feel that the key was beating faster and faster and more violently, as if it would break free from its restraints and fly in a certain direction in the next second.
He and Ao Yanxi looked at each other.
The moment their eyes met, they both saw the same signal in each other's eyes.
The cave is open.
Looking at each other and smiling, with a thought, the figures of several people disappeared from the spot.
Gu Zheng had a key in his hand and entered the cave with Kan Chengxian.
Ao Yanxi had three keys in his hand, which was more than enough.
In fact, even without Kan Chengxian, Gu Zheng could have followed Ao Yanxi in.
However, if there hadn't been the incident of rescuing Kan Chengxian midway, Gu Zheng would have been busy collecting essence on another road at the moment, and he would not have reunited with Ao Yanxi here.
Light and shadow flow, time and space intersect.
When Gu Zheng opened his eyes again, he saw a completely different world.
The sky showed a faint amber color, as if it had been dyed by some ancient halo. There was no sun, but soft light fell from all directions.
In the distance are rolling mountains, towering and shrouded in clouds and mist, and huge birds can be vaguely seen flying through the clouds. The air is filled with rich spiritual energy, which is several times richer than the outside world. You can feel the true energy in the body moving happily with every breath.
This cave can almost be said to be another world.
It may not be as vast as the Daqian territory, but according to the news, it is at least the size of four or five states.
There are mountains, rivers, plains, forests, lakes and swamps, all kinds of landforms, as if a complete ecosystem has been operating independently for tens of millions of years.
Gu Zheng thought about it and tried to communicate the coordinates of the modern world. It was feasible.
He can still travel freely between the two worlds, which gives him a lot of peace of mind.
He withdrew his mind and cast his gaze not far away.
Ao Yanxi, Qing Qing, Aunt Hu, Lin Wen, Lin Wu, Ao Yu, and Kan Chengxian who he brought with him all appeared in the same area intact.
And right in front of them, about a few miles away, stood a city.
The city walls are tall and thick, and the city gates are open. You can vaguely see the people coming and going in the city, and the smoke is curling up. It turns out to be a quite prosperous town.
"Go in and take a look." Ao Yanxi suggested.
Naturally, everyone had no objections and walked towards the city together.
After entering the city, Gu Zheng found that the city was much more lively than expected.
